# Image Outpainting — RunComfy Pro Pack

💳 Paid API required — Curated by Skill Harbor — expand an image's canvas beyond its original borders: outpaint (uncrop) in any direction, convert aspect ratios for different platforms, and extend scenes with content that matches the original's style and perspective. Documents the directional-expansion workflow, the style-matching recipe, and when outpainting beats regenerating the full frame. Discovered via skills.sh, listed here with credit to its creator by @genmedia-labs.
